segments.subtask: The person is sitting on the floor with a shoe in front of them.
The person picks up the shoe.
The person puts the shoe on their foot.
The person adjusts the shoe on their foot.
The person picks up the shoelace.
The person starts tying the shoelace.
The person continues to tie the shoelace.
The person finishes tying the shoelace.
The person finishes adjusting the shoelace.
